title: OS.Sensitivity shape first-boot provisioning descriptor
description: Schema for a per-shape provision.json: the OS-Creator-side declarative config that turns a MINIMAL base ISO into the chosen shape by provisioning packages/commands on first boot. apt is only the Linux provisioner; other shapes declare their own provisioner (rapps for ReactOS, pkg for Darwin). Reproducibility is honored by pinning versions and/or a dated snapshot mirror.

ref.description: Base image/rootfs identifier the Creator starts from (minimal).

source.description: Repo-relative path or upstream the base comes from.

type.description: apt = Debian/Ubuntu (Linux + Wine-on-Linux); rapps = ReactOS; pkg = Darwin/PureDarwin; none = fully baked, no first-boot provisioning.

pinVersions.description: Require exact pkg=version pins for determinism.

snapshotMirror.description: Dated archive snapshot (e.g. https://snapshot.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) for a deterministic first boot.

updateFirst.description: Run the index update (apt-get update) before installing.

version.description: Exact version pin; honored when reproducibility.pinVersions is true.

firstBoot.description: Ordered shell commands run once on first boot after package install.
